description.zh:
指定的客户端ID。

格式：允许英文字母、数字、特殊字符`.-_:/`，不能以特殊字符`.-_:/`开头。

长度：最大128个字符。
description.en:
The client ID that you want to remove.

The client ID can contain letters, digits, and special characters and cannot start with the special characters. The special characters are `periods, (.), hyphens (-), underscores (_), colons (:), and forward slashes (/)`.\`\`

The client ID can be up to 128 characters in length.
The name of the OIDC IdP.

title.zh: 移除OIDC身份提供商中的指定客户端ID

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本文将提供一个示例，为名为`TestOIDCProvider`的OIDC身份提供商移除客户端ID`498469743454717****`。
descriptions.en:
###

This topic provides an example on how to remove the client ID `498469743454717****` from the OIDC IdP named `TestOIDCProvider`.
